gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Cash Basis - Governmental Funds) prints five fund columns; detail has only the General, Street and Lottery budgetary comparison schedules, whose revenue actuals equal those columns (6,579,368 + 1,620,036 + 1,784,916 = 9,984,320). The Debt Service Fund and Community Development Fund columns have no schedule. Debt Service Fund: Property taxes 1,008,444 + Intergovernmental 76,369 + Investment income 11,502 = 1,096,315; Community Development Fund: Investment income 116,870 + Miscellaneous 94,373 = 211,243. Added = 1,307,558. Check: 9,984,320 + 1,307,558 = 11,291,878 = statement Total revenues.
